children: Warren Buffett has stepped aside as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway, with his son Howard taking up the post.

Berkshire Hathaway on Friday said the billionaire investor, who had retired as chief executive of the massive conglomerate at the end of 2025, will now serve as chairman emeritus of the Omaha, Neb., company and remain a member of the board.
